verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly reference official TypeScript and Python SDKs ('npm install supermemory', 'pip install supermemory') that wrap the full API, with extensive documented usage examples (add, search, container tags) across the docs, indicating a mature developer-facing SDK surface. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer corroboration of the SDKs themselves (community evidence only discusses unrelated ingestion/auth complaints) and no visible changelog/versioning evidence for SDK maturity.
